title: Chiyo ()
features:
Auto Farm – Automatically targets and kills zombies with customizable prioritization.
Auto Abilities – Uses all attacks, perks, ultimates, and weapon abilities off cooldown.
Auto Objectives – Teleports to and instantly completes all map objectives, including opening doors and skipping wait times.
Auto Collect – Automatically picks up all nearby coins and item drops.
Auto Queue – Automatically configures and starts matches with your desired settings (Map, Mode, Difficulty).
Auto Roll – Automatically rolls for any specific Trait, Weapon, Perk, Pet, Weapon Effect, or Emote you want.
Auto Craft – Continuously crafts a selected item as long as you have the resources.
Auto Claim – Claims rewards from quests, daily logins, and achievements.
Discord Webhooks – Sends detailed notifications on level completion and player profile stats when joining the lobby.
Misc – Auto-equip selected weapon, auto-replay matches, hop to a new lobby if another player joins, FPS boost.
